tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mig 'byed kyi gdams pa ma rig ling thog sel ba'i gser thur zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo lo ke shwa ra ye/ mnga' bdag myang ral gyi gter ma thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas mig gsal byed kyi gdams pa nyams su len tshul ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum tshad med bzhi/ swa bha wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdakar po las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis sngags chu mig la byugs pa'i phyag rgya can g.yas 'og mas dngul bum bdud rtsis gang ba dang / g.yon 'og mas dngul dkar gyi me long bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan cing / zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i thugs kar hrīḥdakar po'i mthar sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pa mig 'byed phyag rgya'i rtse nas sems can la phog pas rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus nad 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug las gyur pa'i mig nad thams cad zhi bar byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par snying kha'i hrīḥyig sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing ye shes spyan dang ldan par gyur/ phreng ba la grangs bzung la/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ hū ya hū ya/ hū du/ hū du/ ki li/ ki li/ tsak+ṣū mai tri sha trun ya swāhā/ zhes ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar rgyun gtan lag g.yon gyi srin lag gi rtsa ba sngon dang / de min mig gang mi gsal ba'i srin lag gi rtsa bar/ thu gsum/ hū gsum/ phu gsum byas la mchil ma srin rtse g.yas g.yon rtse mos rnal rgyun du mig g.yon sngon dang / de min gang mi gsal ba'i mig phug nas srin lag gnyis bsnol nas g.yas g.yon gyi phyir phugs/ de rjes/

skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar sogs dang / kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang / /gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ /nam mkha'i thar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣū tsak+ṣū sa man+ta tsak+ṣū bi shwa dha ne swāhā/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs kyis bkra shis bya'o// //ces pa 'di yang nyer gnas 'od zer gyi kha ton du sa skya pa kun blos ge re mdo chos gzhis kar sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gzims khang theg chen du sbyar ba kā l+yan wartan+tu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ mig 'byed kyi gdams pa ma rig ling thog sel ba'i gser thur/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
